Standalone direct character-sum determinant enumeration at m=2 and independent symplectic four-mask enumeration at m=2,3 passed. Arbitrary m follows from proof, not experiment.

value.rationale: The theorem solves the four-erasure noise stability problem for the full unbounded hyperbolic quadratic-bent harmonic Parseval family, with exact worst masks, all other spectral types and closed multiplicities. It resolves which erasures are most damaging, rather than simply bounding coherence or recounting the known 60 dependent quadruples in dimension 16. The distinction and all-m uniformity are meaningful for deterministic finite frame sampling.
